title: Tech Note: Creating a Bind in 4D Open for 4D

historical_commentary.text: 4D Open as a distinct plug-in is a legacy product from this era; cross-database or cross-server data access in current 4D is now typically handled through ORDA remote datastores, REST APIs, or 4D's native networking commands, making the specific bind mechanism described here obsolete, though the underlying goal of connecting data across separate 4D systems remains a common architectural need.
related_updates: ORDA remote datastores and REST-based integration have superseded the 4D Open plug-in as the standard way to connect separate 4D systems
